scenario: Per-call `cooldown:` is keyed per call site by the declared `key` slots of the `logical` fact the activation binds ([LCDB.3.3.1]). `Dev` is keyed on `id`; `a` fires the call, `a` again inside the 30 s window (a new `level`, so the rule fires again) is held back, and `b` inside the same window is issued. Expected: two calls, for `a` and for `b`. A tracker keyed on the call site alone would hold `b` back too; one keyed on every slot would let the second `a` through, its `level` having changed. PATH PINNED: the compiler's per-call gate (`dsc.rete.rlow_4_6_6_1_call_gates`), `IF(FN_RATE_ALLOW("r#call0", d.id, 30_s), FN_CALL(...), null)`, evaluated in libds's action loop (`rete/engine.c`, ACTION_CALL) through `adapter_ds_rate_allow`.
rules_ds:
schema Dev scope logical:
    id: String key
    level: Int mutable

service svc.x:
    kwarg id: String
    no response

rule r:
    Dev d
->
    call svc.x id: d.id cooldown: 30_s
